notes: Two runnable projects. LimeFit (the attached single-file fitness app) is the main entry point on host port 3000: nginx serves limefit/www/index.html and the built installer at /LimeFit.apk. Cloud AI is on host port 3100 (Vite dev server + its API on container 127.0.0.1:3001, reached through the Vite proxy, so it stays single-origin and needs no CORS).

The LimeFit APK is built by the one-shot apk-builder service (limefit/Dockerfile.android: JDK 17 + Android cmdline-tools + android-34 + build-tools 34.0.0) running limefit/android/build-apk.sh: aapt2 -> javac -> d8 -> zipalign -> apksigner. No Gradle. Output is limefit/dist/LimeFit.apk (git-ignored, together with the generated debug keystore).
Rebuild the APK after editing limefit/www/index.html with: docker compose -f docker-compose.base44.yml run --rm apk-builder. The web preview and the APK bundle the same file.

The Cloud AI checkout is bind-mounted and dependencies are installed from package-lock.json at container start; edits hot-reload. Its SQLite database, generated images and uploaded attachments live in the cloud_ai_data volume (mounted at /data). Never delete it to refresh dependencies.
Provider credentials are optional: without them the Cloud AI UI shows a setup screen and no model is contacted.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com/api-keys). Enables chat, vision, image generation, server speech and transcription. Optional: the app boots and shows a setup screen without it.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com/settings/keys). Enables Claude models with vision and PDF analysis. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). Enables Gemini models and Imagen 4 image generation. Optional; GEMINI_API_KEY is accepted as an alias.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key for Pro plan checkout. Optional: without it the plan screen explains that payments are not configured and never fakes a purchase.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY
secrets.description: Stripe recurring price ID for the monthly Pro plan. Optional; only needed with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_YEARLY
secrets.description: Stripe recurring price ID for the yearly Pro plan. Optional; only needed with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.
